label: early-sequence punctuation detector
explanation: This feature fires on punctuation marks—especially periods, commas, question marks, and closing quotes—and, more weakly, on common function words like "to", "and", "of", and "that", almost always within the first 15 tokens of a sequence. Strong firing is driven by sentence-final punctuation in early positions; weak firing is spillover onto function words and later positions. It does not fire on the first token and essentially never fires after position 63.
